events.name: Nasha Studio
events.description: A new modular event series launching from the deep end of the signal spectrum, where hypnotic techno, experimental rhythm and system visuals converge in an intimate A/V environment.

videos.cap: Veronique — live set at Pulse Index 001

events.name: Creating Worlds in Touch Designer
events.description: An intensive workshop for intermediate-level artists and creative technologists deepening TouchDesigner skills to create immersive audiovisual work — moving through operator logic, instancing, generative systems, data integration, basic Python and real-time rendering, combining guided exercises with practical strategies for building dynamic audiovisual environments. The focus is on practical, installation-ready experimentation: participants develop sketches or short audiovisual studies, with the possibility of presenting expanded works in future Pulse Index programming.

events.name: Äänen Lumo
events.description: Pulse Index returns with a new live programme exploring experimental sound, moving image and spatial experience. Bringing together artists working across ambient, audiovisual performance and live composition, the evening unfolds as a sequence of immersive sets where sound and image drift between structure and improvisation.

events.name: Pulse Index x Mindscape
events.description: Pulse Index x Mindscape — a Berlin night pairing Static Channel's album release with Katrinø Brægnum (feat. Carri, with lights by Vitalii Mieleshkoi), Raw Image (VJ Lukas Ruoff / ungrid) and DJ Zygonaut.
